summary: L-4 cab built 1931 on Siwash Peak, 10-foot patrol tower a mile north; both destroyed 1961; a 2025 article found tie-downs, a flagpole and foundation cement.

facts.design: L-4 cab on the peak; a 10-foot patrol tower about one mile north on North Siwash Peak
facts.status_note: Cab and patrol tower destroyed in 1961. An August 2025 Idaho Fire Lookouts article reports tie-downs, a flagpole, a section of cement and two cement blocks from the cabin foundation.

access.note: On St. Joe National Forest land and listed as hike-in by Idaho Fire Lookouts. No source gives a trail, route or closure.

notes_for_editor: Cab and tower destruction is dated 1961 by both firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts; no other date. The 2025 remains are described in one source only (Idaho Fire Lookouts), so the site-today text rests on it. Access level public is inferred from National Forest land plus the hike-in label; no trail or closure source found. Idaho Fire Lookouts says it has no documented staffing history, so no staffing fact is recorded. Record kind ground and coordinates match the FFLA list. No record corrections proposed.
